name: NCI/CDC State Cancer Profiles Death Rates (2020–2024)
publisher: National Cancer Institute and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (State Cancer Profiles)
source_release_id: NCI/CDC State Cancer Profiles Death Rates (2020-2024, all/lung/colorectal)

geography_rules.national: FIPS '00000' ('United States'); published once per site from the state file as reference geoid 'US', never drawn as a map feature.
geography_rules.state: State-file rows with FIPS 'SS000' map to 2-digit state GEOID 'SS', joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 states. Non-matching codes are staged as source_only (no_2024_boundary).
geography_rules.county: County-file 5-digit FIPS codes joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 county equivalents. Connecticut's eight former counties (09001-09015) are staged as source_only (legacy_connecticut_county_code) and never crosswalked. The Puerto Rico territory aggregate row (72001) in county files is staged as source_only (puerto_rico_territory_aggregate_not_county).

boundary.vintage: TIGER/Line 2024 states and county equivalents (Connecticut planning regions)

population_label: All ages, both sexes (2000 U.S. standard population)
limitations: These are NCI's age-adjusted death rates for 2020–2024, with 95% confidence intervals. They are deaths, not new cases.
Rates based on few deaths are suppressed by NCI. A suppressed county did not have zero deaths.
Connecticut values are for its former counties and are not shown on the 2024 planning-region boundaries.

measures.label: Cancer death rate, all sites (per 100,000, age-adjusted)
measures.source_field: Age-Adjusted Death Rate([rate note]) - deaths per 100,000
measures.population: All ages, both sexes (2000 U.S. standard population)
measures.denominator: 100,000 population, all ages and both sexes, age-adjusted to the 2000 U.S. standard population.
measures.official_definition: Age-adjusted cancer death rate across all cancer sites per 100,000 population (2020–2024) from National Vital Statistics System public use data calculated by NCI using SEER*Stat.
measures.interpretation: Death rates, not new cancer incidence. Rates based on fewer than 16 deaths in 2020–2024 are suppressed by NCI. Published with 95% confidence intervals.
